name: Ace of Cups
upright: New love, emotional fulfillment, compassion, creativity, spiritual awakening.
reversed: Blocked emotions, apathy, emotional drought, overflow, suppressed feelings.

name: Two of Cups
upright: Partnership, mutual attraction, unity, reconciliation, friendship, connection.
reversed: Disagreement, broken bond, imbalance, tension, ending a relationship.

name: Three of Cups
upright: Friendship, celebration, community, support, networking, joyful gathering.
reversed: Oversharing, gossip, exclusion, overindulgence, strained friendships.

name: Four of Cups
upright: Contemplation, apathy, boredom, meditation, rejecting offers, introspection.
reversed: Opportunity, gratitude, motivation, waking up, seizing the moment.

name: Five of Cups
upright: Regret, sorrow, grief, loss, disappointment, focusing on negatives.
reversed: Acceptance, forgiveness, moving on, recovery, hope, learning from loss.

name: Six of Cups
upright: Nostalgia, childhood memories, innocence, reunion, kindness, past connections.
reversed: Living in the past, moving on, leaving behind, unresolved issues, nostalgia trap.

name: Seven of Cups
upright: Choices, illusions, fantasy, wishful thinking, many options, daydreaming.
reversed: Clarity, decision made, focus, reality check, choosing wisely, grounding.

name: Eight of Cups
upright: Walking away, disillusionment, seeking higher purpose, leaving behind, quest.
reversed: Fear of change, staying in comfort zone, avoidance, reluctance to leave.

name: Nine of Cups
upright: Contentment, satisfaction, wishes granted, emotional fulfillment, luxury.
reversed: Disappointment, ungratefulness, materialism, dissatisfaction, empty gains.

name: Ten of Cups
upright: Family harmony, happiness, lasting love, domestic bliss, ideal relationship.
reversed: Broken family, disharmony, shattered dreams, divorce, unhappy home life.

name: Page of Cups
upright: Creativity, imagination, intuition, emotional message, artist, dreamer.
reversed: Emotional immaturity, insecurity, disappointment, blocked creativity, cynicism.

name: Knight of Cups
upright: Romantic gesture, charm, diplomacy, following heart, invitation, suitor.
reversed: Moodiness, emotional blackmail, unrealistic romance, betrayal, sulking.

name: Queen of Cups
upright: Compassion, empathy, calm, nurturing, intuitive, emotionally balanced.
reversed: Dependence, insecurity, mood swings, martyrdom, emotional volatility.

name: King of Cups
upright: Emotional control, diplomat, compassionate leader, counselor, balanced feelings.
reversed: Coldness, manipulative, moody, distant, bad advice, emotional flooding.
